summary: MarketAxess Holdings Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 30, 2026, reporting its second-quarter 2026 financial results and declaring a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.78 per share, payable September 2, 2026. The filing is routine operational reporting under Items 2.02 and 8.01, with no special-situation transaction, strategic review, or corporate action. No deal terms, premiums, or unusual events are present. The dividend is part of ordinary capital allocation. This is not a special situation; it is a standard earnings and dividend announcement.
